content: In addition, some researchers; proposed an approach based on Collaborative Filter (CF) Algorithm and utilized the application of session variety and temporal context. They applied a LDA model to temporal properties extraction of sessions and that considering sessions as documents and songs as words. For evaluation of this approach, they used Last.fm dataset(log) that includes 19,150,868 entries from 992 users. Results showed that the approach with using temporal information can increase the accuracy of music recommendations BIBREF54.
